title: iniBuilds Announces Global FBO, Bringing Luxury Business Aviation Facilities to MSFS 2024
summary: iniBuilds unveils Global FBO for MSFS 2024, introducing luxury VIP lounges, exclusive business aircraft parking, restaurants, gyms and a collectible Trophy Room at selected airports.
body:
# iniBuilds Announces Global FBO, Bringing Luxury Business Aviation Facilities to MSFS 2024

iniBuilds has officially unveiled **Global FBO**, a new business aviation experience for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, bringing purpose-built executive aviation facilities to selected iniBuilds airports around the world.

![](/assets/iniFBOSocials1.png)

Announced through the developer's official Discord server on 6 November 2026, Global FBO aims to expand the executive aviation experience beyond the aircraft itself, introducing luxurious VIP terminals, exclusive aircraft parking and a range of interactive-style facilities designed around business aviation operations.

The announcement follows recent previews of iniBuilds' upcoming Global Jet, although the developer has not yet clarified whether the two products will be directly linked.

![](/assets/iniFBOSocials2.png)

## A New Home for Business Aviation

Global FBO introduces dedicated Fixed Base Operator (FBO) facilities at selected iniBuilds airports worldwide.

In real-world aviation, FBOs provide services to private and business aircraft operators, including passenger handling, aircraft servicing and access to private terminals.

For MSFS 2024 enthusiasts, the addition of purpose-built FBO facilities promises to create a more convincing environment for executive jet operations.

Rather than simply arriving at a conventional airport terminal, virtual business aviation pilots will have access to facilities designed specifically for private and corporate aviation.

## Luxury VIP Facilities

![](/assets/iniFBOSocials3.png)

According to iniBuilds, Global FBO will feature a range of premium facilities, including:

- Detailed VIP lounges.
- Restaurants and hospitality areas.
- Gym facilities.
- Exclusive parking areas for business aircraft.
- A collectible Trophy Room.
- Integration through iniManager.

The developer's accompanying screenshots reveal an impressive modern terminal design, complete with extensive glass frontages, architectural lighting and dedicated aircraft parking.

Interior previews show luxurious lounge seating, decorative lighting and a fully modelled bar area, reflecting the premium surroundings associated with real-world executive aviation terminals.

The announcement also highlights a collectible Trophy Room, although further details about how this feature will operate have not yet been provided.

## Integration with iniManager

iniBuilds has confirmed that Global FBO will feature integration through its iniManager application.

This suggests that iniManager will play a role in accessing or managing the new facilities, although the precise functionality has not yet been explained.

The developer has not confirmed whether Global FBO will be available at every iniBuilds airport or published a complete list of participating locations.

For now, availability is described as being limited to selected iniBuilds airports worldwide.

## Expanding the Executive Aviation Experience

The announcement is particularly interesting given iniBuilds' ongoing development of its Global Jet for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

Based on the Bombardier Global 6000, the Global Jet project has already attracted attention for its detailed passenger cabin, custom avionics and executive aviation features.

Global FBO could provide a complementary environment for pilots operating business jets, allowing flights to begin and end at dedicated executive terminals rather than conventional passenger facilities.

However, iniBuilds has not confirmed whether Global FBO will be included with the Global Jet, offered separately or made available through another distribution arrangement.

The two developments should therefore be treated as separate announcements until further details are provided.

![](</assets/Real Life 1.png>)

## Release Date, Pricing and Availability

At the time of the announcement, iniBuilds had not provided confirmed pricing or a release date for Global FBO.

The developer has also not yet published a complete list of supported airports or detailed requirements for accessing the facilities.

Further information is expected as iniBuilds expands on the initial announcement.

## BizJet Pilot's View

Global FBO represents an interesting development for business aviation enthusiasts using Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

While considerable attention is usually focused on aircraft systems, avionics and flight dynamics, the environment surrounding executive aviation operations is equally important to creating an immersive experience.

Dedicated FBO facilities, luxury passenger lounges and exclusive aircraft parking could help make virtual business aviation operations feel more authentic.

The potential relationship between Global FBO and the upcoming iniBuilds Global Jet is particularly intriguing, although the developer has yet to confirm how the two offerings will work together.

BizJet Pilot will continue monitoring iniBuilds for further information about supported airports, functionality, pricing and availability.
